data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 abstracts SRC_002: SRC_004's mechanism frames the provider-call temporal boundary as the invariant under mutation, whereas SRC_002 operationalizes a specific violation (typed exception to generic). SRC_004 thus abstracts SRC_002 by separating the temporal invariant from the typed-contract invariant. This abstraction is refuted if SRC_002's typed exception is the only machine-checkable signal for the temporal precondition, meaning the temporal boundary depends on the typed contract and cannot be abstracted away from it.
